title: Carbon Footprint Value-Only Schema
description: JSON schema for value-only representation of IDTA 02023-1-0 Carbon Footprint submodel template

ProductCarbonFootprints.description: Balance of greenhouse gas emissions along the entire life cycle of a product in a defined application and in relation to a defined unit of use.

ProductOrSectorSpecificCarbonFootprints.description: Product Carbon Footprints, which is determined in accordance with sector or product group-specific rules or guidelines and covers the life cycle or parts of a product life cycle.

CarbonFootprint.description: The Submodel provides the means to access the Carbon Footprint of the asset.

PcfCalculationMethods.description: Standards, methods for determining the greenhouse gas emissions of a product.

PcfCO2eq.description: Sum of all greenhouse gas emissions of a product according to the quantification requirements of the standard.

ReferenceImpactUnitForCalculation.description: Quantity unit of the product to which the PCF information on the CO2 footprint refers.

QuantityOfMeasureForCalculation.description: provides the quantity number of pieces or mass or volume to compute the impact of climate change or product carbon footprint.

LifeCyclePhases.description: List of life cycle stages of the product according to the quantification requirements of the standard to which the PCF carbon footprint statement refers

ExplanatoryStatement.description: Explanation required or provided to ensure that a footprint communication can be properly understood by a purchaser, potential purchaser, or user of the product.

GoodsHandoverAddress.description: Indicates the hand-over address of the goods transport

PublicationDate.description: The UTC timestamp on which a Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) - a calculation of a product's total greenhouse gas emissions - was created and published

ExpirationDate.description: End date up to which a study or data collection for calculating an ecological footprint is considered current and valid before an update or new calculation is required.

ProductCarbonFootprint.description: Balance of greenhouse gas emissions along the entire life cycle of a product in a defined application and in relation to a defined unit of use.

PcfCalculationMethods.description: Standards, methods for determining the greenhouse gas emissions of a product.

ProductOrSectorSpecificRule.description: Contains further information on the product-specific or sector-specific rule used to calculate the carbon footprint.

ExternalPcfApi.description: An external service that provides carbon footprint information via an interface, allowing on-demand retrieval of this data when required.

PcfInformation.description: A section in which further content is listed according to the calculation method for the Product Carbon Footprint.

ProductOrSectorSpecificCarbonFootprint.description: Product Carbon Footprint, which is determined in accordance with sector or product group-specific rules or guidelines and covers the life cycle or parts of a product life cycle.

PcfRuleOperator.description: Organization that defines and implements specific instructions and methods for calculating and monitoring the carbon footprint of a product or sector.

PcfRuleName.description: Standard, method for determining the greenhouse gas emissions of a product

PcfRuleVersion.description: Specific version or revision of the rule used to calculate the carbon footprint of a product.

PcfRuleOnlineReference.description: Online PCF calculation methodology reference that provides detailed instructions and guidelines for calculating a product's carbon footprint.

ProductOrSectorSpecificRule.description: Contains further information on the product-specific or sector-specific rule used to calculate the carbon footprint.

PcfApiEndpoint.description: Specific URL or address that can be used to retrieve data from external sources to calculate the carbon footprint of a product.

PcfApiQuery.description: Specific query that can be used to retrieve data from external sources to calculate the carbon footprint of a product.

ExternalPcfApi.description: An external service that provides carbon footprint information via an interface, allowing on-demand retrieval of this data when required.

ArbitraryContent.description: Free area for structured collection of specific items of a specific PCF.

PcfInformation.description: A section in which further content is listed according to the calculation method for the Product Carbon Footprint.
